lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਲਾਲ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਰਬ ਸਾਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohan laal anoop sarab saadhaareeaa ||
lines.translation: The Fascinating and Beauteous Beloved is the Giver of support to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਿਖਾਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur niv niv laagau paai dehu dikhaareeaa ||3||
lines.translation: I bow low and fall at the Feet of the Guru; if only I could see the Lord! ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਕੀਏ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਇਕਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai keee mitr anek ikas balihaareeaa ||
lines.translation: I have made many friends, but I am a sacrifice to the One alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੀਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sabh gun kis hee naahi har poor bha(n)daareeaa ||4||
lines.translation: No one has all virtues; the Lord alone is filled to overflowing with them. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: chahu dis japeeai naau sookh savaareeaa ||
lines.translation: His Name is chanted in the four directions; those who chant it are embellished with peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਆਹੀ ਓੜਿ ਤੁਹਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: mai aahee oR tuhaar naanak balihaareeaa ||5||
lines.translation: I seek Your Protection; Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿਓ ਭੁਜਾ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਮੋਹ ਕੂਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaadhio bhujaa pasaar moh koopaareeaa ||
lines.translation: The Guru reached out to me, and gave me His Arm; He lifted me up, out of the pit of emotional attachment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਜੀਤਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: mai jeetio janam apaar bahur na haareeaa ||6||
lines.translation: I have won the incomparable life, and I shall not lose it again. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai paaio sarab nidhaan akath kathaareeaa ||
lines.translation: I have obtained the treasure of all; His Speech is unspoken and subtle.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਰੀਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: har daragah sobhaava(n)t baah ludaareeaa ||7||
lines.translation: In the Court of the Lord, I am honored and glorified; I swing my arms in joy. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਧਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ladhaa ratan amol apaareeaa ||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has received the invaluable and incomparable jewel.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਕਹਉ ਪੁਕਾਰੀਆ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa bhaujal tareeai kahau pukaareeaa ||8||12||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean; I proclaim this loudly to all. ||8||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: naaraain har ra(n)g ra(n)go ||
lines.translation: Dye yourself in the color of the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਮੰਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap jihavaa har ek ma(n)go ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the One Lord with your tongue, and ask for Him alone. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਭਜੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj haumai gur giaan bhajo ||
lines.translation: Renounce your ego, and dwell upon the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਲਿਖਿਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mil sa(n)gat dhur karam likhio ||1||
lines.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, join the Sangat, the Holy Congregation. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਗਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so sa(n)g na gaio ||
lines.translation: Whatever you see, shall not go with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤੁ ਮੂੜੁ ਲਗੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਇਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saakat mooR lage pach muio ||2||
lines.translation: The foolish, faithless cynics are attached - they waste away and die. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohan naam sadaa rav rahio ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Fascinating Lord is all-pervading forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹਿਓ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kot madhe kinai guramukh lahio ||3||
lines.translation: Among millions, how rare is that Gurmukh who attains the Name. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sa(n)tan kar namo namo ||
lines.translation: Greet the Lord's Saints humbly, with deep respect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਸੁਖੋ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: nau nidh paavahi atul sukho ||4||
lines.translation: You shall obtain the nine treasures, and receive infinite peace. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੈਨ ਅਲੋਵਉ ਸਾਧ ਜਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: nain alovau saadh jano ||
lines.translation: With your eyes, behold the holy people;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧੋ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai gaavahu naam nidho ||5||
lines.translation: in your heart, sing the treasure of the Naam. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਜੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu tajo ||
lines.translation: Abandon sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਹੁ ਤੇ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran duhu te rahio ||6||
lines.translation: Thus you shall be rid of both birth and death. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਮਿਟਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookh a(n)dheraa ghar te mitio ||
lines.translation: Pain and darkness shall depart from your home,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ਦੀਪ ਬਲਿਓ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur giaan driRaaio deep balio ||7||
lines.translation: when the Guru implants spiritual wisdom within you, and lights that lamp. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin seviaa so paar pario ||
lines.translation: One who serves the Lord crosses over to the other side.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਿਓ ॥੮॥੧॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak guramukh jagat tario ||8||1||13||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, the Gurmukh saves the world. ||8||1||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਗਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 5 gauRee ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl, Gauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਭਰਮ ਗਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har gur gur karat bharam gae ||
lines.translation: Dwelling upon the Lord, Har, Har, and the Guru, the Guru, my doubts have been dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai man sabh sukh paaio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My mind has obtained all comforts. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਤੋ ਜਲਤੋ ਤਉਕਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: balato jalato taukiaa gur cha(n)dan seetalaaio ||1||
lines.translation: I was burning, on fire, and the Guru poured water on me; He is cooling and soothing, like the sandalwood tree. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: agiaan a(n)dheraa mit gaiaa gur giaan deepaaio ||2||
lines.translation: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled; the Guru has lit the lamp of spiritual wisdom. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਕੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗਹਰੋ ਚਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਨਾਵ ਤਰਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: paavak saagar gaharo char sa(n)tan naav taraaio ||3||
lines.translation: The ocean of fire is so deep; the Saints have crossed over, in the boat of the Lord's Name. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਚ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਆਪਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naa ham karam na dharam such prabh gahi bhujaa aapaaio ||4||
lines.translation: I have no good karma; I have no Dharmic faith or purity. But God has taken me by the arm, and made me His own. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bhau kha(n)dan dukh bha(n)jano bhagat vachhal har naaio ||5||
lines.translation: The Destroyer of fear, the Dispeller of pain, the Lover of His Saints - these are the Names of the Lord. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਸੰਤ ਓਟਾਇਓ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: anaathah naath kripaal deen sa(n)mrith sa(n)t otaaio ||6||
lines.translation: He is the Master of the masterless, Merciful to the meek, All-powerful, the Support of His Saints. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: niraguneeaare kee benatee dehu daras har raaio ||7||
lines.translation: I am worthless - I offer this prayer, O my Lord King: "Please, grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan." ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਓ ॥੮॥੨॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saran tuhaaree thaakur sevak duaarai aaio ||8||2||14||
lines.translation: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, O my Lord and Master; Your servant has come to Your Door. ||8||2||14||
